construction: Normal generator selects one of 12 profiles, target 0..4, independent signs and shifts, with scale 1. CLI retries up to max(100,count*100), rejecting repeated mathematical fingerprints. No correctness-based rejection. Replay exhaustion and inconsistent template/profile are rejected rather than silently returning fewer records.
limitations: Focused finite stream exercises duplicate rejection only when duplicates occur; code inspected for rejection predicate.
